tagline: Global leader in golf equipment, apparel, and complementary soft goods with strategic focus on core golf business.
hero_kpi_rationale: The sale of Jack Wolfskin and Topgolf operations represents a major strategic pivot for Callaway, refocusing the company on its core golf equipment business.

kpis.name: Net proceeds from divestitures
kpis.explanation: Amount received from the sale of non-strategic operations after deduction of transaction costs.
kpis.description: Net proceeds received from the sale of 60% of Topgolf and Toptracer (equity value $1.1B, net $800M) and 100% of Jack Wolfskin (net $290M).

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin measures direct profitability of sales after deducting production costs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin indicates profitability of core operations before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D investments are critical for the development of new products and technologies.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (equipment spending)
kpis.explanation: Spending on tangible and intangible fixed assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures support growth and maintenance of the company's asset base.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Total headcount is an indicator of operational capacity and personnel costs.
kpis.signal: Reflects the size and structure of operations.

kpis.name: Sales Returns Reserve
kpis.explanation: Estimate of sales that will be returned by customers.
kpis.description: A 10% increase in this reserve would have reduced pre-tax income by $6.4 million for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Potential impact on revenue if underestimated.

kpis.name: Sales Program Incentives
kpis.explanation: Cost of promotions and discounts offered to customers.
kpis.description: A 10% increase in the rate used for these incentives would have reduced pre-tax income by $1.5 million for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Potential impact on revenue if misestimated.

kpis.name: Inventory Obsolescence/Excess Reserve
kpis.explanation: Provision for write-down of unsaleable or obsolete inventory.
kpis.description: A 10% increase in this reserve would have reduced pre-tax income by $2.1 million for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Potential impact on earnings if inventory valuation is inaccurate.

risks.title: Cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions risks related to cyberattacks and data breaches, indicating awareness of the risk. The language used is strong, and the current cybersecurity threat landscape reinforces the severity of the risk.

risks.title: Regulations
risks.score_rationale: The company must comply with strict regulations, particularly regarding data protection. Non-compliance could result in fines and financial losses.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, meaning it must continuously innovate and improve its products to remain competitive. The language used indicates awareness of competition and the need to differentiate.

risks.title: Asset Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company holds assets that could rapidly depreciate, particularly due to technological obsolescence. The language used indicates awareness of this risk and the need for effective asset management.

risks.title: Divestiture-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company completed major divestitures in 2025 (Jack Wolfskin and 60% of Topgolf), meaning it must manage reverse integration risks and maintain the value of the remaining 40%. The language used indicates awareness of these risks and the need for effective management.
